title: The Crooked Ember Revisited
premise: Jude Delacroix has spent a decade as the crown's food-taster, dosing himself with harmless charms to survive in a city where magic is punishable by fire. When he discovers tonight's date inscribed in the Ember Codex, a century-old book of prophecies, he learns he is named as the Covenant-Bearer who must reforge the broken pact between the human city of Vell and the hidden realm of Ashmoor. Hunting the codex's missing pages through smugglers' dens, royal archives, and the ash-choked borderlands, Jude uncovers that the king's own spymaster shattered the covenant to seize power. In the climax, Jude chooses justice outside the law, exposing the spymaster before the assembled realms and rekindling the Crooked Ember itself. The covenant reforged, Jude finds belonging at last—not in the palace that used him, but among the outcasts who kept the old faith alive.
about_author: Kestrel Lockridge is the pen name of a former archivist who spent years cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about ordinary people caught in machinery far older than themselves.

chapters.title: The Taster's Table
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. On the eve of his tenth year of service, Jude samples the king's feast and slips his nightly charm into his wine, reflecting on the quiet loneliness of a life built on small illegal magics. A hooded stranger leaves him a note naming an impossible date. Emotional beat: restless unease beneath routine.

chapters.title: A Date Written in Ash
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. Following the note to a shuttered apothecary, Jude meets Sera Vane, a disgraced court scribe who shows him the Ember Codex—where tonight's date, his name, and his role are written a century ago. He refuses to believe it until a minor charm he casts flares unnaturally bright. Emotional beat: disbelief curdling into dread.

chapters.title: The Missing Leaves
chapters.summary: POV: Sera. Sera reveals three pages were torn from the codex decades ago and hidden by the Order of the Quiet Flame, the outlawed remnant of Ashmoor's faithful. She recruits Jude with the promise that fulfilling the prophecy could pardon every convicted witch in Vell. Emotional beat: reluctant hope kindling into purpose.

chapters.title: Smoke Over the Saltmarket
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. Their first lead dies violently—a charm-seller found burned in his stall, ruled accidental by guards who clearly lie. Jude realizes someone powerful is erasing the covenant's trail, and that his own immunity makes him both useful and disposable. Emotional beat: grief sharpening into vigilance.

chapters.title: The Spymaster's Ledger
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. Posing as a loyal taster, Jude infiltrates the palace archive and finds Lord Corvane's private ledger: payments, burnings, and a record of the night the covenant was deliberately broken. Corvane catches him lingering and offers promotion—the velvet threat. Emotional beat: terror braided with resolve.

chapters.title: What the Border Remembers
chapters.summary: POV: Sera. Journeying to the ash-choked borderlands, Sera and Jude find the second page guarded by an exiled Ashmoor keeper, Mother Ilex, who tests them with memory-rites: they must each recite a wrong they committed and let it be witnessed. Jude confesses the prisoners his testimony condemned. Emotional beat: shame transmuted into accountability.

chapters.title: The Hollow Crown's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. Corvane summons Jude privately, revealing he knows everything, and offers him wealth and pardon if he delivers the pages—or his friends will burn in his place. Jude pretends to accept while passing word to the Quiet Flame through Sera. Emotional beat: cornered cunning, loyalty under pressure.

chapters.title: Night of the Long Fire
chapters.summary: POV: Sera. Corvane moves first: raids on the Quiet Flame's safehouses, Sera captured, the third page seized. Jude races through burning streets, trading his last protective charms to smugglers for passage into the palace dungeons. Emotional beat: desperation at full gallop, allies scattered.

chapters.title: The Crooked Ember
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. At the ruined covenant-stone beneath the palace, Corvane forces Jude to complete the rite in his name—but prophecy required a bearer who chose freely. Jude instead speaks the confession-rite aloud before gathered guards, exposing Corvane's crimes; the Ember answers Jude's honest hand and blazes whole. Emotional beat: defiant sacrifice becoming triumph.

chapters.title: Belonging, Reforged
chapters.summary: POV: Jude. Weeks later, magic is decriminalized, the convicted freed, and Corvane faces lawful judgment Jude no longer needs to deliver personally. Offered a court title, Jude declines, choosing instead to teach charms in the Saltmarket beside Sera and Mother Ilex. Emotional beat: quiet, earned belonging.
